name: Regional long-term care ombudsman, Wisconsin Board on Aging and Long Term Care
organization: Regional long-term care ombudsman, Wisconsin Board on Aging and Long Term Care
description: The regional long-term care ombudsman for this county: advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and residential care facilities.
next_step: Call the regional ombudsman program. Give the facility name and county. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.
Say your county and the name of the nursing home or assisted living community. In Milwaukee County, also give the ZIP code.

The state ombudsman program serves residents age 60 and older. For residents ages 18–59, the state’s health department points to a separate ombudsman program at Disability Rights Wisconsin, 800-928-8778.
Calls are answered Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m., except state holidays.
